t: SUNY Press - SUNY System
s: The Press’s mission emphasizes service to three key stakeholder audiences: the SUNY community; the academic and scholarly community; and — through its trade imprint and partnerships with cultural and community organizations — the broader general public, especially throughout New York State. SUNY Press sponsors nationally recognized and rapidly growing lists of scholarly publications in the areas of philosophy, Jewish studies, religion, Asian studies, education, political science, transpersonal psychology, women's studies, queer studies, African American studies, Italian American studies, and indigenous studies. Through its Excelsior Editions trade imprint, SUNY Press makes available exceptional works for all readers and showcases the diversity and abiding energy of the peoples, histories, and natural beauty of the New York region.
